_comment: Hand-picked background settings for generate_character_art.py, keyed by character id. Each setting places the character at the location of their own single most iconic/defining scene (see DATA_MODEL.md item 90 for how each was chosen). Not auto-derived from Story data yet -- this is a curated batch of 25 major characters; per-character setting selection is still a manual/creative judgment call, not mechanical.
char_adam: the lush Garden of Eden at dawn, sunlight filtering through dense trees and exotic plants
char_eve: the lush Garden of Eden at dawn, a fruit tree softly visible behind her, sunlight filtering through dense trees
char_noah: the deck of a massive wooden ark, a dramatic stormy sky breaking apart into a rainbow
char_abraham: beneath a vast desert night sky thick with stars, silhouetted tents and dunes in the distance
char_isaac: a stone altar atop Mount Moriah at sunrise, a ram caught in a nearby thicket softly visible
char_jacob: a rocky hillside at Bethel by night, a faint luminous stairway rising into a starlit sky in the far background
char_joseph: the grand columned halls of an Egyptian palace, golden granaries and hieroglyph-carved walls softly visible
char_rebekah: a stone well outside a Mesopotamian village at dusk, camels resting softly in the background
char_moses: the rocky slopes of Mount Sinai, dramatic storm clouds and light breaking through above the peak
char_david: the green hillside pastures outside Bethlehem at golden-hour dusk, sheep grazing softly out of focus
char_solomon: the columned inner court of the First Temple in Jerusalem, warm torchlight on carved stone and gold
char_deborah: beneath a great palm tree on a hillside in Ephraim, tribal tents and gathering elders softly visible beyond
char_gideon: a hillside at night, three hundred torches glowing warmly in the darkness among distant tents

char_samson.description: Samson, judge of Israel, famed above all for supernatural God-given physical strength -- a powerfully built, broad-shouldered, heavily muscular figure, radiating raw physical might even in this final act
char_samson.setting: gripping and straining with immense force against the two massive stone pillars of a Philistine temple hall as they begin to crack under his supernatural strength, muscles visibly tensed in his arms and neck, a powerful defiant stance, warm torchlight and a crowded feast softly visible beyond

char_ruth: golden barley fields at harvest under a warm afternoon sun, workers gleaning softly out of focus

char_samuel.description: Samuel, a venerable elder statesman among prophets -- the respected judge of Israel in his later years who anointed both King Saul and King David
char_samuel.setting: a modest stone dwelling in Ramah, a ram's horn of anointing oil resting on a table beside him, a wooden staff nearby, warm late-afternoon light through a doorway

char_elijah: the summit of Mount Carmel, a dramatic pillar of fire descending from a stormy sky onto a stone altar
char_isaiah: a heavenly temple throne room, vast smoke-filled columns and soft radiant light suggesting an overwhelming vision
char_jonah: the storm-tossed deck of a ship at sea, dark waves and the shadow of a great sea creature beneath the surface
char_daniel: a torchlit stone den, several lions resting calmly nearby in the shadows
char_esther: the opulent columned throne hall of a Persian palace, rich tapestries and golden light
char_mary: a humble stable in Bethlehem by candlelight, a wooden manger and soft hay visible
char_jesus: a sunlit grassy hillside overlooking the Sea of Galilee, a gathered crowd softly visible in the distance
char_peter: the shore of the Sea of Galilee at dawn, fishing boats and nets softly visible on the water behind him

char_paul.setting: a dusty desert road near Damascus, a blinding radiant light breaking through the sky above

char_sarah: beneath the great trees of Mamre outside her tent, warm daylight, distant hills
char_rachel: a rocky well outside Haran, flocks of sheep gathered around, golden late-afternoon light
char_leah: inside a large family tent encampment, soft lamplight, woven textiles in the background

char_miriam.description: Miriam, prophetess of Israel and older sister of Moses and Aaron, celebrated for leading the women of Israel in triumphant song and dance
char_miriam.setting: the shore of the Red Sea, timbrel in hand, women dancing and celebrating softly in the background, bright morning light

char_aaron: before the golden altar of incense inside the tabernacle, priestly breastplate and robes, warm lamplight
char_joshua: standing before the massive walls of Jericho at dawn, ram's horn trumpets and armed ranks softly visible behind him
char_caleb: the rugged hill country around Hebron, rocky highland terrain, a determined stance, golden late-day light
char_rahab: a window in the stone wall of Jericho, a scarlet cord tied outside, rooftops of the city below
char_boaz: his own barley fields at harvest time in Bethlehem, workers and sheaves of grain softly visible, warm sunlight
char_saul: a grand tent encampment on a hilltop battlefield, spear in hand, royal robes, a stormy sky overhead
char_goliath: the valley of Elah, a massive armored figure with spear and shield, the Israelite and Philistine armies faced off in the distance
char_jonathan: a rocky battlefield ridge, bow in hand, royal armor, the mountains of Gilboa in the background
char_bathsheba: the columned interior of the royal palace in Jerusalem, regal robes befitting a queen mother, warm golden light
char_absalom: a dense forest during a chaotic battle at dusk, his long hair tangled in the branches of a great oak overhead
char_nathan: the columned throne room of the palace in Jerusalem, standing firm before a throne, dramatic torchlight
char_elisha: the banks of the Jordan River, Elijah's mantle in hand, water parting softly in the background
char_jeremiah: the ruins of Jerusalem's walls at dusk, smoke rising in the distance, a scroll in hand
char_ezekiel: a dramatic apocalyptic vision, swirling storm clouds, wheels of fire and radiant light in the sky behind him
char_job: a windswept ash heap outside the city under a dramatic stormy sky, a whirlwind gathering above
char_nehemiah: atop the newly rebuilt stone walls of Jerusalem at night, torches along the wall, the city below
char_ezra: before a great assembled crowd, a large scroll of the Law unrolled in his hands, morning light in an open square
char_mordecai: the ornate gate of the Persian palace at Susa, columned architecture, official robes
char_john_the_baptist: the banks of the Jordan River in the wilderness, camel-hair clothing, rugged desert hills behind him
char_mary_magdalene: a garden at dawn beside an open stone tomb, soft golden sunrise light breaking through
char_lazarus: stepping out from a stone tomb entrance in Bethany, wrapped grave clothes, soft warm light breaking through the tomb opening

char_cain.setting: a barren field outside Eden, dry cracked earth, distant storm clouds

char_abel.setting: a green pastoral hillside with grazing flocks, warm morning light, an altar of stones nearby

char_esau.setting: the rugged hill country of Seir, a hunting bow and animal skins, rocky wilderness terrain

char_laban.setting: a sheep-herding camp in Haran, flocks and tents in the background, late-day light

char_pharaoh.setting: the grand columned throne hall of an Egyptian palace, golden hieroglyph-carved walls, guards softly visible

char_balaam.setting: a rocky hillside overlooking the encamped tents of Israel below, a donkey softly visible nearby

char_achan.setting: outside an Israelite camp near Jericho, a tent and buried plunder softly visible at his feet

char_eli.setting: seated beside the doorpost of the tabernacle at Shiloh, dim evening light

char_jezebel.setting: an ornate palace balcony overlooking Jezreel, richly adorned in royal Phoenician dress

char_ahab.setting: the throne room of the palace in Samaria, ivory-inlaid walls, a troubled dusk light

char_naboth.setting: his own vineyard on a hillside in Jezreel, warm golden-hour light, rows of grapevines

char_gehazi.setting: the road outside Naaman's departing chariot, the dusty hills of Samaria in the distance

char_naaman.setting: the banks of the Jordan River, armor set aside, radiant morning light after his healing

char_hezekiah.setting: the inner court of the First Temple in Jerusalem, royal robes, warm devotional light

char_josiah.description: Josiah, king of Judah in his mid-twenties, at the height of his reign -- a grown adult man, not a boy or child -- who instituted sweeping reforms after the Book of the Law was rediscovered in the temple
char_josiah.setting: the temple courts in Jerusalem, an ancient scroll of the Law in hand, warm daylight

char_nebuchadnezzar.setting: the grand terraces of Babylon overlooking the city, royal Babylonian robes, golden sunset light

char_belshazzar.setting: a lavish Babylonian banquet hall, golden vessels on the table, mysterious glowing writing faintly visible on the wall behind him

char_cyrus.setting: the columned Persian court at Babylon, royal robes, a decree scroll in hand

char_zerubbabel.setting: the half-rebuilt foundation of the Second Temple in Jerusalem, warm morning light, workers softly visible

char_barnabas.setting: the early church gathered in a courtyard in Antioch, warm daylight, a welcoming presence

char_stephen.setting: before the Sanhedrin's council chamber, a soft radiant light on his face, onlookers softly visible

char_ananias.setting: the gathered early church in Jerusalem, a bag of silver coins softly visible in hand, uneasy tension in the air

char_simon_magus.setting: a marketplace in Samaria, a bag of coins extended in hand, onlooking apostles softly visible

char_judas_iscariot.setting: a torchlit garden at night, a small bag of silver coins visible at his side

char_pilate.setting: a Roman judgment hall in Jerusalem, a basin of water softly visible nearby, columned architecture

char_hagar.setting: beside a desert spring in the wilderness of Shur, water jar at her feet, wide open desert horizon

char_lot.setting: a hillside overlooking the plain of Sodom, distant fire and smoke rising against a dark sky

char_ishmael.setting: the wilderness of Paran, bow and quiver, rugged desert terrain under a wide sky

char_jochebed.setting: the reedy bank of the Nile at dawn, a small woven basket softly visible among the reeds

char_pharaohs_daughter.setting: the reedy bank of the Nile, Egyptian royal linen and jewelry, attendants softly visible behind her

char_zipporah.setting: a stone well in Midian, flocks of sheep gathered around, golden desert light

char_naomi.setting: the dusty road back to Bethlehem at harvest time, distant barley fields visible

char_elimelech.setting: a parched, famine-stricken field on the road toward Moab, dry cracked earth

char_orpah.setting: a quiet crossroads at the edge of Moab, a modest Moabite village softly visible behind her

char_nadab.setting: before the bronze altar of the tabernacle, unauthorized fire flaring dramatically upward

char_abihu.setting: the tabernacle courtyard at dusk, unauthorized fire and censer softly visible, a tense atmosphere

char_korah.setting: an Israelite desert camp, the ground dramatically cracking open at his feet

char_eleazar.setting: inside the tabernacle before the golden altar of incense, priestly breastplate and robes, warm lamplight

char_ehud.setting: the cool upper chamber of a Moabite king's palace, a hidden double-edged dagger softly visible

char_barak.setting: the base of Mount Tabor, ten thousand Israelite troops gathered on the slopes behind him

char_sisera.setting: a fleeing war chariot on a rain-soaked battlefield near the Kishon river, dark storm clouds overhead

char_jael.setting: the entrance of her own tent among Kenite herding camps, a tent peg and mallet in hand

char_jephthah.setting: the rugged hill country of Gilead, a battle-worn commander's cloak, distant armed ranks

char_jephthahs_daughter.setting: a mountainside in Gilead, timbrel in hand, companions softly visible in the distance

char_delilah.setting: a lamplit chamber in the valley of Sorek, a pair of shears resting on a table nearby

char_hannah.setting: the doorway of the tabernacle at Shiloh, hands lifted in quiet prayer, warm morning light

char_michal.setting: a palace window overlooking Jerusalem's streets, arms crossed, a procession softly visible below

char_uriah.setting: a war camp outside Rabbah at night, armor and shield resting nearby, campfires softly visible

char_tamar.setting: a quiet inner courtyard of the palace in Jerusalem, a torn ornate robe softly visible

char_amnon.setting: a private chamber in the palace in Jerusalem, dim uneasy lamplight
